description: In a countable first-order language, \(T\) is complete if and only if it is syntactically consistent and proves one of \(\theta,\neg\theta\) for every sentence \(\theta\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.complete_iff_consistent_decides.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable L.Symbols]
  (T : L.Theory) :
  T.IsComplete ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T ∧
      ∀ (φ : L.Sentence),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T φ ∨
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not φ)
